Trails.Name: Lost in the Woods (Lower) Uphill Route
Lost in the Woods (Upper) Uphill Route

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Friday, April 24, 2026 8:30 AM – Top to bottom laps are on tap under partly cloudy skies this morning. Temps are pleasant, winds are light, and snow conditions are in great shape across the mountain. We could see some weather develop later today. 14 lifts are currently spinning, conditions permitting. Canyon Lodge will reopen for access only Saturday, April 25 and Sunday, April 26. Canyon Express (16) and the Village Gondola will be spinning, with rentals, tickets, retail, and parking available. Beginner skiers and riders should plan to ski and ride out of Main Lodge for the best experience. Consider taking the free Mountain Shuttle to the mountain this morning, with service from around Mammoth Lakes to Main Lodge. Start your morning by carving a few laps down Fascination and enjoy the early conditions.  
  
Conditions and Visibility: Mostly sunny skies, temps in the 30s, and light winds. Snow is soft and light, so get out there and find those hidden stashes. 
Lift status: 14 lifts are scheduled to spin, conditions permitting. Please note, Chair 7, Chair 8, Cloud Nine Express (9), Eagle Express (15), Schoolyard Express (17), Chair 20, Chair 21, Chair 22, and Chair 25 have wrapped up operations for the season. Canyon and Eagle Lodges are now closed for the season.  
Winter Activity status: Sno-Go Ski Bike Tours are available Sunday-Thursday, weather permitting. Woolly’s Adventure Summit is closed for the winter season and is scheduled to reopen May 22 for the summer. Tamarack Cross-Country Ski Center and Snowmobile Adventures are closed for the season.
Safety: Fresh snow may look inviting, but hazards like dirt, rocks, and bushes remain just below the surface. Ski and ride with caution and be aware when venturing off trail. Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is: 760.934.0611  
Road Conditions: Roads are mostly clear, but snow and ice may exist in shady areas. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest status.
